about: The order of the exam-paper workflow, read by skill/scripts/next_step.py. Steps run one at a time, in this order. A step is next when every step before it is done and it is not. 'by' says who does the step; 'waitsForUser' marks the approval points where work stops until the user answers. 'done' is checked against the task folder (paths are relative to it). Format: see next_step.py.

steps.title: Validate the spec
steps.note: If it fails, show the errors verbatim and stop; the user decides how to fix the spec.

steps.title: Make the blueprint
steps.note: CONCEPT_LIST is the concept list found in step 0. If the spec changed after the blueprint was made, the blueprint is out of date.

steps.title: Show the blueprint and get the user's approval
steps.run: Show the blueprint as SKILL.md step 2 says, then wait. On approval, change only "status" to "approved" in TASK/blueprint.json.

steps.title: Draft questions.json and its diagrams
steps.run: Write TASK/questions.json from the approved blueprint (and TASK/make_diagrams.py with its images).

steps.title: Check the questions
steps.note: Fix every error and rerun until it passes.

steps.title: Blind solver
steps.run: Spawn one subagent with the full text of agents/blind-solver.md, input TASK/review/solver-input.json and output TASK/review/solver-answers.json. Wait for it to finish.

steps.title: Compare the solver's answers with the key
steps.note: Exit code 1 means mismatches, not a failure. Show the output verbatim.

steps.title: Independent reviewer
steps.run: Spawn one subagent with the full text of agents/reviewer.md and the paths SKILL.md step 5.4 lists; output TASK/review/reviewer-report.json (it makes TASK/review/reviewer-report.html). Wait for it to finish, then print the findings with python3 skill/scripts/render_review.py TASK/review/reviewer-report.json, show them verbatim and send the user the HTML report.
steps.note: The reviewer runs once, before the first fix decision; later rounds only rerun the blind solver.

steps.title: The user decides which fixes to apply
steps.run: Ask the user which findings and mismatches to fix, then write their answer to TASK/review/fixes.json: {"accepted": ["R1", ...], "rejected": [...]}.
steps.note: Also asked again when a later comparison finds mismatches.

steps.title: Apply the accepted fixes
steps.run: Edit TASK/questions.json for the accepted fixes only. next_step.py then sends you back through the check and the blind solver.

steps.title: Build the PDFs
steps.note: Open both PDFs and look at them before delivering.

steps.title: Deliver the PDFs
steps.run: Send both PDFs to the user with the path of TASK and any warnings that remain.
